_schema.purpose: Machine-readable state of every verified quality defect. One row per defect, keyed by a stable fingerprint so the same defect is never counted twice across daily/weekly/monthly runs. Not a second database — a checked-in artifact, updated in the same commit that changes a defect's state.

fields.first_seen: ISO date the defect was first verified
fields.evidence: file:line or observed fact that proved it real
fields.verification: how the fix was proven, or null
fields.release: sha or tag containing the fix once deployed, or null
fields.recurrence: count of times this exact fingerprint re-appeared after being marked fixed

_schema.repair_eligibility: Track C-4. A defect may be prepared as an isolated repair PR ONLY if eligible=true. Eligible: deterministic lint/type errors with one correction, stale dep patches with passing tests, a guard broken by an explicit contract change, a missing no-store header on authenticated content, reproducible null handling, wrong static copy or route reference. NEVER eligible: billing mutation, auth architecture, authorization logic, migrations, legal/compliance policy, encryption, secrets, data deletion, subscription cancel/refund, production config, cross-tenant behaviour, or any uncertain business intent. No repair auto-merges.
